title: Assistant Accountant
description:
Assistant Accountant
Banbury £33,000 to £38,000 + up to 5% bonus Office based Permanent

Looking for a hands-on accounting role where no two days are the same? Our client, a well-established global engineering manufacturer based in Banbury, is looking for an Assistant Accountant to join finance team. This is a newly created role, brought in to support the Finance Manager as the business continues to grow.

What's on offer
- Salary of £33,000 to £38,000, depending on experience
- Discretionary bonus of up to 5%
- Early finish every Friday at 12:45
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
- A varied, all-round role with exposure to group and international reporting

Interested? Apply now!

title: Practice Bookkeeper / Management Accountant
description:
Management Accountant / Bookkeeper

Henley-on-Thames £32,000 - £40,000 + Bonus + Hybrid Working + Flexitime + 2:30pm Friday Finish

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Management Accountant / Bookkeeper to join a highly regarded and growing accountancy and advisory practice based in the beautiful riverside town of Henley-on-Thames.

The firm supports an impressive portfolio of entrepreneurial businesses, owner-managed companies, high-net-worth individuals and international groups. Rather than simply providing compliance services, the practice prides itself on technical expertise, commercial insight and building long-term client relationships.

This is an opportunity to become a trusted part of your clients' finance function, with genuine client interaction, responsibility and the opportunity to develop your management accounting skills within a supportive and collaborative team.

Henley-on-Thames provides an exceptional working environment, combining beautiful riverside surroundings, excellent amenities and a vibrant business community. The firm is also a proud sponsor of the Henley Royal Regatta, giving employees the opportunity to attend and enjoy this iconic annual event.

The Role

As a Management Accountant / Bookkeeper, you will work closely with a varied portfolio of clients, delivering high-quality bookkeeping and management accounting services while becoming a trusted point of contact for financial support and guidance.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Daily bookkeeping using Xero and cloud-based accounting systems
- Processing purchase invoices, sales invoices and accounting transactions
- Bank reconciliations and maintaining accurate accounting records
- Reconciling control accounts including VAT, payroll, debtors and creditors
- Reviewing bookkeeping completed by junior team members
- Posting monthly payroll journals
- Preparing monthly and quarterly management accounts
- Producing financial reports and supporting schedules
- Preparing and submitting VAT returns across a variety of VAT schemes
- Preparing and submitting CIS returns
- Liaising directly with clients regarding accounting queries
- Providing Xero support and training to clients
- Attending client premises where required
- Supporting ad-hoc accounting and finance projects

This role offers excellent variety and exposure and would suit someone who enjoys working with clients and wants to develop their technical and commercial accounting expertise.

About You

We are keen to hear from candidates with strong bookkeeping experience and a proactive, client-focused approach.

The ideal candidate will have:
- Previous bookkeeping experience within an accountancy practice or outsourced finance environment
- Experience preparing and submitting VAT returns
- Strong control account reconciliation experience
- Previous management accounts experience is advantageous
- AAT Qualified (highly desirable)
- Candidates qualified by experience will also be considered
- Strong working knowledge of Xero
- Xero certification advantageous
- Experience with Datamolino, Expensify, Concur or Fathom beneficial but not essential
- Excellent Excel, Word and Outlook skills

This role would suit an experienced Bookkeeper seeking greater responsibility, or a Management Accountant looking to join a progressive practice where client relationships and career development are genuinely valued.

The Offer

In return, you will receive a competitive package and the opportunity to join a business that genuinely values its employees.

Benefits include:
- £32,000 - £40,000 salary, dependent on experience
- Hybrid working
- Flexible working arrangements and flexitime
- 2:30pm finish every Friday
- Discretionary annual bonus
- Full study support where required
- Pension scheme
- 23 days' annual leave plus bank holidays
- Additional holiday entitlement with service and qualification progression
- Corporate rewards and benefits platform
- Quarterly social events
- Free on-site parking
- Ongoing training and professional development
- Genuine opportunities for progression and increased responsibility

The firm has built a reputation for creating an environment where people enjoy coming to work. Modern systems, supportive leadership, flexibility and a strong focus on development provide an excellent platform for someone looking to build their career within practice.

Apply Now

If you are an experienced Management Accountant, Bookkeeper, Senior Bookkeeper or Assistant Management Accountant looking for your next challenge, we would be delighted to hear from you.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a growing and respected advisory practice in one of the UK's most sought-after locations, working with a diverse and interesting client base while enjoying genuine flexibility, progression and a strong work-life balance.

Apply today to take the next step in your accounting career.

title: Remote Conveyancing Paralegal
company: LEGAL TALENT PARTNERS LIMITED - Agency - Permanent
description:
Remote Conveyancing Paralegal

£30,000-40,000

Quality. Technology. Flexibility. A Better Way to Do Conveyancing.

We're partnering with a fast-growing, forward-thinking residential conveyancing firm that is using technology, smarter processes and a collaborative team structure to change the way property law is delivered.

The firm is built around a simple idea: conveyancing should be simpler, clearer and faster - for clients and the people delivering it.

If you're an experienced conveyancing paralegal looking for greater autonomy, better technology, a sustainable workload and the flexibility of a fully remote role, this could be an excellent next move.

Why This Role Stands Out

This is not a traditional conveyancing environment where paralegals are left to manage overwhelming caseloads with little support.

You'll work within small, collaborative teams, with regular check-ins, structured 1-to-1s, feedback and personalised training.

The firm takes a quality over quantity approach to workload, maintaining sustainable caseloads and giving teams capacity to deal with peaks without compromising client service.

You'll benefit from:
- Sustainable caseloads and a strong focus on work-life balance
- Small, collaborative teams
- Regular support, feedback and development
- Bespoke technology designed around legal teams
- A culture where asking for help is encouraged
- The opportunity to influence how technology and processes develop
- Fully remote working with genuine flexibility

The result? A more manageable workload, better support and the freedom to focus on delivering excellent conveyancing rather than simply processing as many files as possible.

The Role

As a Conveyancing Paralegal, you'll be an integral part of a residential conveyancing team, working alongside lawyers and other paralegals to deliver an excellent client service.

You'll work across freehold and leasehold sales, purchases and remortgages, taking ownership of your matters while working collaboratively with the wider team.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Progressing residential sales, purchases and remortgages
- Handling freehold sales with minimal supervision
- Managing most leasehold sale enquiries with minimal supervision
- Managing most freehold purchase enquiries with minimal supervision
- Liaising with clients, solicitors, estate agents and other third parties
- Proactively identifying issues and keeping transactions moving
- Reviewing and responding to enquiries
- Maintaining clear, jargon-free communication
- Using the firm's technology to manage your caseload efficiently
- Identifying and resolving potential issues before they become blockers
- Providing feedback to improve systems and processes

The firm's technology has been developed specifically around its conveyancing process, and legal professionals are encouraged to provide feedback on the tools they use every day.

About you

You'll ideally have:
- Strong experience in residential conveyancing
- Experience handling freehold sales with limited supervision
- Experience dealing with leasehold sale enquiries
- Experience dealing with freehold purchase enquiries
- Confidence communicating with clients and third parties
- A proactive approach to progressing transactions
- Strong organisation and attention to detail
- Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
- Confidence working independently in a remote environment
- An interest in using technology to improve legal work

You don't need to be qualified. This role is suited to an experienced paralegal with strong technical conveyancing skills who is ready to take greater ownership of their work.

Although fully remote, you won't be left alone with a laptop and a pile of files. Regular team check-ins, 1-to-1s and ongoing feedback are built into the firm's approach.

The Culture:

This is a firm deliberately doing things differently.

Rather than chasing maximum utilisation, it takes a sustainable approach to workload, helping teams maintain consistent service levels while giving people room to deal with the unexpected.

Its technology helps allocate work, streamline processes and keep teams informed, while its remote-working model is built around communication, supervision, feedback and development.

There's also a strong culture of transparency and continuous improvement. People are encouraged to share ideas, challenge processes and help shape the future of the business.

The Package
- £30,000-£40,000 depending on experience
- Fully remote - work from anywhere in the UK
- Flexible working hours
- 25 days' holiday + 3 days at Christmas + Bank Holidays
- Full home-working setup and equipment provided
- Comprehensive private healthcare
- Free access to Spill mental health and wellbeing support
- Company pension scheme
- Enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption leave
- Growth Shares, giving employees an opportunity to share in the long-term success of the business
- Fully paid-for annual company weekend
- Structured development and genuine progression opportunities

The firm's flexible approach is a key part of its culture, with many employees working flexible hours or part-time. The focus is on creating working patterns that work for both the individual and the wider team.

If you're an experienced conveyancing paralegal looking for a genuinely modern, supportive and flexible place to build your career, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: The Receptionist will provide an efficient and effective service for patients and members of the practice. The post holder will ensure that all patients and visitors are welcomed to the practice in a professional manner whilst adhering to the practice data and confidentiality policy. The Receptionist is part of the Customer Services Team and the first point of contact for patients playing a very important role as part of The Abingdon Surgery team. Key Responsibilities: Act as the first point of contact for patients, clinicians, and visitors to the department dealing with all face-to-face contacts in an efficient, polite, and courteous manner and responding to all telephone enquiries in a prompt and professional manner Deal with patient enquiries in an empathetic and confidential manner, signposting people appropriately and always maintaining a high standard of customer care Ensure that patients are checked in and out of clinics accurately and in a timely manner Book all follow-up appointments Be responsible for recording DNAs accurately including contacting patients regarding the reason for not attending Ensure that the reception area is always kept clean and tidy. Book interpreter services for patients as required Take responsibility for all communications received and distribute appropriately to the clinical and administrative staff within the service Explain practice arrangements and formal requirements to new patients and temporary residents, ensure procedures are completed Advise patients of relevant charges for private services, accept payment and issue receipts for same Produce repeat prescriptions according to practice procedures and ensure timely distribution or completed prescriptions Replenishment of reception area consumables Complete all training as required by the practice. Vaccinations clinic assistant where required. Demonstrate high levels of customer care and be an ambassador for customer care within the practice Provide robust administration functions that underpins the delivery of high-quality service and maintain effective working relationships with clinical and administrative staff Answer communication including telephone, email, and face-to-face queries and in timely manner and action as appropriate Always maintain patient confidentiality Be flexible in approach to work, such as covering other job roles at an appropriate grade or site, including varying working hours to ensure that the service maintains an adequate level of cover during core hours Use the IT systems to register patients, make up a set of patient notes, make patient appointments, produce letters, ensure that details are correct, check in/out of patient appointments as instructed Attend departmental meetings and training as required to ensure that up-to-date working knowledge of service and practice procedures is maintained Act in a manner aligned with the Practice Values and consistently demonstrate the behaviours that will ensure the achievement of delivering compassionate care and excellence Perform any other duties commensurate to the grade, at the request of the departmental managers, which may be needed to fulfil the objectives of the post The job description is an outline of the key tasks and responsibilities of the Receptionist and is not intended as an exhaustive list. The job may change over time to reflect the changing needs of the Trust and its services as well as the personal development needs of the post-holder. Any variation will be agreed in advance between the post-holder and the Reception Manager as part of the continuing process of management review and development.
